full_text: Hi, I'm calling to schedule an appointment for my daughter. She's 6 years old and this would be her first dental visit. Her name is Lily Martinez. My name is Maria Martinez. I'm her mom. My number is 555-888-9999 and my email is maria.martinez@email.com. We have MetLife dental insurance. She's just never been to the dentist before and I want to get her started. Do you have a doctor who's good with kids? She's a little nervous about it. Wednesdays or Fridays work best for us. After school, so maybe around 3 or 4 PM?
